gates.condition: Xcode 26.6 build 17F113 is the exact Chromium M152 toolchain for upstream, development and release profiles, with macOS SDK 26.5 build 25F70 and iOS SDK 26.5 build 23F81a. Pinned-reference and compatible-development remain separate provenance labels even though they select the same installation.

The normal Chromium checkout/build recommendation remains 150 GiB free. For this explicitly supervised M152 run, AHOI_ALLOW_LOW_DISK=1 may proceed below that recommendation, but every checkout and build fails closed below the hard 120 GiB safety floor. Available space is measured again at each command start; the override is local authorization only and is not release evidence.
Widevine MLA, partner access and redistributable ARM64 CDM are not yet available.
Written H.264/AAC patent and distribution assessment is required before public binaries.
Register final Mac/iOS bundle IDs, iCloud container and Developer ID/iOS provisioning profiles.

The fail-closed attested chain and independent live-bundle validator are implemented and tested. No exact candidate has yet been bound to the available Developer ID identity, Apple notarization and stapling, a production-key-signed manifest and DMG-installed bundle receipts; CU_E2E and ASSISTED_E2E PASS therefore remain disabled.

A valid Developer ID Application identity is locally available. Release remains blocked until the reviewed release environment binds that identity and Team ID, a Keychain-backed notarytool profile is provided, and the exact app and DMG are submitted, accepted, stapled and validated. The locally verified Apple Development signature is not release evidence.
Provision and independently pin one Ed25519 release-manifest public key plus distinct nightly, beta and stable Sparkle signing keys. Private keys must remain outside the repository.
Provide reviewed HTTPS artifact and appcast endpoints for every enabled channel, publish signed metadata and complete N-2/N-1, interruption, disk-full, fallback and rollback-prevention journeys.
Verify that Google still permits install, update and removal of ordinary MV3 Chrome Web Store extensions in the signed installed AhoiBrowser build.
Configure only permitted Google API services and keys; Chrome Sync, private Chrome APIs and chrome.identity.getAuthToken are not inherited by this fork.
Confirm permitted Safe Browsing credentials, terms, endpoint set and privacy behavior for a third-party Chromium distribution.
Add the signed app through 1Password's Additional Browsers flow and verify extension, Native Messaging and Touch ID with a synthetic test vault.
Provide synthetic 1Password and Bitwarden test vaults and approve Touch ID/System Authentication prompts on the test Mac; no real credentials may be used or recorded.
Complete physical Magic Mouse/trackpad and media-key journeys plus macOS camera, microphone and screen-capture TCC prompts on the signed installed build.
After final identifiers and entitlements exist, validate the production CloudKit container with two Macs and one real iPhone or iPad; simulator and provider-free tests are not substitutes.
Confirm source/license compliance and name/logo use for an Ahoi-signed uBO Classic package.
Approve the AhoiBrowser trademark/name/logo policy, Chromium and third-party notices, corresponding-source offer and all public distribution channels before a public candidate is published.
